title: Alerts
description: Stops, targets, price levels and the opening bell. Each alert rings once.
placeholder: Your alerts and the alert log will appear here.

table.title: Your alerts
table.ringsOnce: Alerts are checked against free delayed quotes while the engine runs. Each one rings once; re-arm it to use it again. Times are New York (ET).

empty.title: No alerts yet
empty.description: Add the stop, target and flat-by alerts from a trade plan in one click, or create a custom one.

delete.title: Delete this alert?
delete.description: {{name}} {{symbol}} {{value}} will be removed and won't ring.

fromPlan.title: Add alerts from a plan
fromPlan.description: Creates three alerts from the run's exit plan: the stop, the target and "flat by close" at your flat-by time.
fromPlan.emptyHint: Run the pipeline first. Its exit plan holds the stop and the target.

form.description: Pick what should ring. Prices are in USD; times are New York (ET).

typeHints.above: Rings when the price trades at or above the level.
typeHints.below: Rings when the price trades at or below the level.
typeHints.stop: Rings when the price falls to your stop loss.
typeHints.target: Rings when the price reaches your take profit.
typeHints.pct_move: Rings when the price moves this much, up or down, from the previous close.
typeHints.time: Rings at a time of day, for example a reminder to check a trade.
typeHints.open_bell: Rings when the NYSE opens at 09:30 ET (skips weekends and holidays).
typeHints.flat_by: Reminds you to close your day trades before the market closes.

form.symbolHint: US stock symbol, e.g. TSLA or BRK.B.
form.levelHint: Checked against delayed quotes, so it can ring a little late.
form.pctHint: 3 means a move of 3 % either way.
form.flatByHint: Leave empty to use the flat-by time from Settings.

errors.symbol: Enter a ticker like TSLA or BRK.B

errors.alert_not_found: That alert doesn't exist anymore. The list has been refreshed.
errors.no_plan: This run has no exit plan yet. Finish the exit step first.
errors.fill_in_use: A later sell uses the shares from this buy. Delete that sell first.

sentence.flat_by: {{value}}: close your {{symbol}} day trade before the bell

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: How Levelset tells you an alert rang. Saved on this computer.
notifications.desktopHint: Shows a Windows notification even when Levelset is in the background.
notifications.browserHint: Available in the desktop app. In the browser demo you get in-app messages only.
notifications.denied: Windows notifications are blocked. Allow them for Levelset in Windows Settings > Notifications.
notifications.soundHint: Plays a short chime with the in-app message.
notifications.testBody: This is how an alert will look.
